description: Audit-recommended variant of the paper-ready 20-500 mixing sweep: fixed_stratified_test (small+large fixed test), per_structure loss weighting, 3 selection seeds. Costs ~3x the single-seed run.

run_order: 1. Confirm datasets exist: graphene_5x5_snapshot_scaling_20_50_80 (iid20, iid50) and graphene_5x5_snapshot_scaling_100_500_mixing (iid100..iid500) -- both already generated on disk.
2. Launch this payload through /api/mixing/launch or the E2E wrapper (run_mixing_e2e_payload_once.py).
3. Expect 8 sizes x 2 modes x 3 ratios = 48 permutations, 96 model runs for Graph2Mat+DeepH (single seed, no replication).
notes.single_seed_note: No seeds replication (seed=0 only), per user request. This is a single training pass per permutation, NOT publication-grade (audit I5 requires >=3 seeds for MAE-vs-size claims with error bars). Treat curves from this sweep as exploratory point estimates.
notes.hyperparams_note: Added because the automatic mixing sweep only exposes 'epochs' as an override; without 'hyperparams' it silently trains with the small MD/pipeline_config.yaml defaults (hidden_irreps=10x0e+10x1o+10x2e, batch_size=10, lr=0.005) instead of the paper-ready T600/750-epoch anchors (hidden_irreps=64x0e+64x1o+64x2e+64x3o, batch_size=40, lr=0.0018). Values copied verbatim from Comparison/config/mixing_sanity_size500_*_paper_ready_anchors_payload.json.

estimated_disk_gb.basis: measured 1.5 GB for a single size=500 permutation with these exact hyperparameters (Comparison/results/mixing_sanity_500_paper_ready_anchors), scaled linearly by nominal size with a 20% fixed-checkpoint floor

notes.split_policy_note: fixed_common_test: test set fijo derivado solo del pool small + seed, compartido por todas las permutaciones del mismo tamano.
notes.iid_naming_note: Los datasets *_iid* NO son muestras iid: son frames MD consecutivos (1 fs) agrupados en bloques de temperatura. Ver docs/known_limitations.md.
notes.ghost_exemption_note: confirm_ghost_species_exemption=true: los datasets small (W90, con Ghost-H) y large (5x5, solo C) tienen especies ghost distintas; la exencion se declara explicitamente aqui.
